messages:
morgan: heads-up — after the eu-west deploy we saw a spike of TLS errors from the proxy cluster, lots of session resume failures and unexpected SNI mismatches. see sample logs below.

sasha: can you paste a concise log slice + which service IDs impacted?

morgan: paste from proxy (truncated):
```
2026-03-21T08:12:11Z proxy-23 eu-west-1 cert_lookup: found cert for svc-prod-3
2026-03-21T08:12:11Z proxy-23 eu-west-1 tls_handshake: client_hello sni=svc-prod-3.example.internal session_ticket=abc123
2026-03-21T08:12:11Z proxy-23 eu-west-1 tls_resume: ticket_decrypt_err KMS:AccessDenied principal=arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/cert-distributor
2026-03-21T08:12:11Z proxy-23 eu-west-1 tls_fail: ERR_SSL_SESSION_ID_NOT_FOUND
```

morgan: impacted services: svc-prod-1/2/3 behind that route, ~20% of connections errored for ~6m.

arjun: curious — we pushed an RBAC tweak to the cert-distributor role yesterday (narrowed kms:Decrypt to a new key alias). did we also update the rotator / distribution job?

sasha: yes we tightened the key policy. service that reads ticket keys is the same cert-distributor lambda. if it lost decrypt, session ticket unwrapping fails and proxies log decrypt errors.

ops-oncall: deploy-bot shows a canary at 07:48 with the new policy. metrics show KMS Deny spikes at 08:11 — correlation looks strong.

deploy-bot: Audit summary: CloudTrail shows 132 KMS:DecryptDenied events for principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/cert-distributor between 08:10:55 and 08:12:20 (eu-west-1). Related PR: #4842 (rbac/kms-tighten).

morgan: ok — immediate mitigation: revert that PR or add explicit allow for alias/sessions-key. we need short-lived mitigation to restore session ticket decryption so proxies can resume.

arjun: doing a scoped allow now: temp policy attached to role to allow kms:Decrypt on alias/sessions/eu-west (30m). will note for rollback.

sasha: after that, please check the session ticket key rotation job — it writes wrapped keys to S3 and relies on KMS decrypt when proxies fetch on restart. if proxies rely on live decrypt during handshake (we do for session ticket keys), this is attack surface.

ops-oncall: we still have residual SNI mismatches logged — looks like older proxies cached a cert with different CN. Could be simultaneous config rollout vs. cert swap. recommend forcing a config reload across proxies after we restore decrypt.

morgan: agree. plan: 1) temp allow KMS decrypt (done) 2) reload proxies in eu-west in 2 waves (canary + remainder) 3) increase audit retention for proxy logs and cloudtrail for 30d for this incident 4) follow-up: make session ticket key unwrap tolerant to KMS Deny and fall back to fresh handshake.

arjun: actioned: attached temp allow at 08:22, verifying.

deploy-bot: Verification: KMS:Decrypt success for role cert-distributor observed at 08:23:05.

sasha: after reload canary at 08:28 we saw resume rate return to baseline. running full reload now.

morgan: incident notes to capture for postmortem:
- Root cause: RBAC change narrowed KMS decrypt permission without updating distribution workflows.
- Symptom: session ticket unwrap failures -> TLS resume errors + increased full handshakes -> latency spike.
- Areas for improvement: map KMS key aliases to all consumers (cert distribution, session ticket unwrap, rotator). enforce CI gating when RBAC changes touch KMS aliases consumed by runtime.

ops-oncall: one more ask — add an alert: when KMS:DecryptDenied > 0 in 5m for roles tagged cert-consumer -> page eng-security and oncall. Also add a dashboard showing session_resume_rate by region.

arjun: adding alert rule, will PR to infra-alerts and annotate with the incident id.

morgan: assigning follow-ups: @arjun add temp-policy rollback + PR to fix key alias mapping; @sasha write postmortem draft with timeline & mitigation; @ops-oncall add alerts + dashboard.

sasha: I'll start the postmortem draft, include audit log snippets and the CloudTrail query used. quick CT query I ran:
```
lookup EventName="Decrypt" OR EventName="Decrypt*" | where EventSource=="kms.amazonaws.com" and recipientAccountId=="111222333444" | where eventTime between("2026-03-21T08:00:00Z","2026-03-21T09:00:00Z")
```

morgan: also need to model systemic hardening: make proxies tolerate transient KMS failures by falling back to full handshake without failing; and consider caching unwrapped session ticket keys rotated with a short TTL that can replay during KMS outages.

ops-oncall: note for compliance: record of RBAC change must include test plan showing no KMS consumer regressions before apply. I'll add to secure-deploy checklist. :clipboard:

morgan: thanks all — closing the immediate thread. we'll circulate the postmortem and link the incident doc. :thumbsup:
